element.name: Configure Azure AD as Corporate Identity Provider
Deploy SAP IAS Tenants (S/4HANA and SuccessFactors)
Deploy SAP IPS Tenants (S/4HANA and SuccessFactors)
Configure SCIM Provisioning to SAP S/4HANA Cloud
Configure SCIM Provisioning to SAP SuccessFactors
System shall provision users automatically from Azure AD via SAP Cloud Identity Services
System shall support SCIM-based provisioning through SAP IPS
System shall enforce Single Sign-On via SAP IAS for all SAP applications
System shall maintain identity isolation per landscape stage (Development / Acceptance / Production)
System shall de-provision (deactivate) users within 24 hours of Azure AD deactivation
System shall log all identity lifecycle events for audit purposes
System shall support role-based access assignment during provisioning
Risk: Incomplete or Inaccurate Azure AD Attribute Data
Risk: SCIM Mapping Errors Between Azure AD and SAP Fields
